title.zh: V8 是怎么跑起一段 JavaScript 的

desc.zh: 在终端敲下 node bench.js，动态类型的 JavaScript 没有提前编译成机器码，却能在热循环里跑出接近 C 的速度。这篇对照宿主机 V8 14.6.202.34-node.40（Node.js v26.12.1）的真实字节码、调试输出与参数阈值，从头拆解这条流水线：四级 JIT 与懒解析、指针标签与压缩、隐藏类与内联缓存、Ignition 累加器字节码、投机去优化、ElementsKind 单向格、Orinoco 分代垃圾回收、微任务接缝，以及 2026 年 11 月的前沿。
desc.en: Run node bench.js in a terminal and dynamically typed JavaScript, compiled with no ahead-of-time type annotations, hits near-C speed inside hot loops. Checked against the host V8 14.6.202.34-node.40 (Node.js v26.12.1) bytecode, native debug prints, and CLI thresholds, this essay traces the whole pipeline: the four JIT tiers and lazy parsing, pointer tagging and compression, hidden classes and inline caches, Ignition's accumulator bytecode, speculative deoptimization, the one-way ElementsKind lattice, Orinoco generational GC, the microtask seam, and the November 2026 frontier.

title.zh: V8 四级执行管线与懒解析

desc.zh: V8 从解析器和 Ignition 字节码起步，只在函数变热后才依次升入 Sparkplug、Maglev 与 TurboFan/Turboshaft，冷函数靠预解析跳过建树。
desc.en: V8 begins with PreParser and Ignition bytecode, stepping up through Sparkplug, Maglev, and TurboFan/Turboshaft only after functions prove hot.

title.zh: 指针标签、Smi 与指针压缩

desc.zh: V8 用字最低比特区分直接整数 Smi 与堆指针，Chrome 借 4 GiB 笼做 32 位压缩将对象减半，浮点数则装箱为 HeapNumber。
desc.en: V8 marks every tagged word's low bit to separate inline Smis from heap pointers, shrinking words to 32-bit offsets inside Chrome's 4 GiB cage while boxing floats as HeapNumber.

zh: JS 数值在内存里怎么存

title.zh: 隐藏类（Map）、Slack 追踪与字典模式
title.en: Hidden classes (Maps), slack tracking & dictionary mode

desc.zh: 同键序对象共享同一张 Map 把属性名换成固定字节偏移；乱序会令转换树分叉，第 7 次构造完成 Slack 缩容，delete 则跌入字典模式。
desc.en: Objects sharing property order share one Map of fixed byte offsets; reordering forks the transition tree, constructor slack trims on call 7, and delete falls back to dictionary mode.

en: why delete property is slow in JS

title.zh: 内联缓存（LoadIC）：单态、多态与超态

desc.zh: 每个属性读取点在 FeedbackVector 槽里缓存最多 4 张 Map 的偏移；超出 4 种形状就落入全局哈希桩进入慢速超态。
desc.en: Each property site caches up to 4 Map offsets inside its FeedbackVector slot; seeing a 5th shape spills into the global megamorphic stub cache.

zh: 单态 多态 超态
为什么超过 4 种对象形状变慢

title.zh: Ignition 累加器字节码与 FeedbackVector

desc.zh: Ignition 以隐式累加器 acc 缩减字节码体积，同时把运行时观测到的 Map 与算术类型写入并行的 FeedbackVector 供给后续 JIT。
desc.en: Ignition keeps bytecode compact with an implicit accumulator register while streaming live Map and arithmetic types into FeedbackVector slots.

title.zh: 投机优化、OSR 与去优化退回

desc.zh: Maglev 与 TurboFan 靠 CheckMaps 与 CheckSmi 守卫裸奔；一旦条件打破就触发 Eager Deopt，在栈上重建 Ignition 帧安全退回。
desc.en: Maglev and TurboFan emit CheckMaps and CheckSmi guards around fast machine code, reconstructing exact Ignition stack frames on any bailout.

title.zh: 数组 ElementsKind 单向转换格

desc.zh: JS 数组底层按 PACKED_SMI 到 HOLEY_ELEMENTS 与字典单向退化；产生空洞或混入异类后，缩回 length 也无法回升。
desc.en: V8 tracks array backing layouts from PACKED_SMI to HOLEY_ELEMENTS and dictionaries along a strictly one-way lattice that never upgrades back.

zh: JS 数组空洞为什么慢

title.zh: Orinoco 分代与并发垃圾回收

desc.zh: 新生代靠半区复制 Scavenger（或 MinorMS）实现亚毫秒回收；老生代靠三色并发标记与写屏障清理，逼到上限才全停顿整理。
desc.en: NewSpace runs sub-millisecond Scavenger copies (or MinorMS), while OldSpace uses concurrent tri-color marking with write barriers unless promotion forces a Major Mark-Compact.

zh: JS 为什么突然卡顿 GC

title.zh: 事件循环与微任务检查点接缝

desc.zh: V8 只拥有调用栈和微任务队列；每轮同步结束必须彻底排空 nextTick 与 Promise 微任务才把控制权交还宿主宏任务。
desc.en: V8 owns only the call stack and MicrotaskQueue, draining every nextTick and Promise job at MicrotaskCheckpoint before yielding back to host macrotasks.

zh: 微任务和宏任务执行顺序

title.zh: Turboshaft、V8 堆沙箱与 WebAssembly JSPI 前沿
title.en: Turboshaft, V8 Heap Sandbox & WebAssembly JSPI frontier

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的 V8 前沿演进：Turboshaft 替代 Sea of Nodes、V8 堆沙箱、WebAssembly JSPI 交付及 Turbolev/MinorMS 实验路标。
desc.en: V8's November 2026 frontier: Turboshaft replacing Sea of Nodes, the V8 Heap Sandbox, WebAssembly JSPI shipping, and experimental Turbolev and MinorMS flags.
